label: Recipe and cooking instructions
explanation: Fires on tokens embedded in recipe/cooking passages, especially ingredient nouns, measurements, and imperative cooking verbs such as Add, cook, and serve; it fires most strongly on these central cooking words and at sequence starts, and weakly on surrounding function words in the same passages. It stays mostly silent outside food-preparation text, though weak firings occur on food-adjacent topics like diet, restaurants, and markets, plus occasional subword false positives.
